title.narrative: Vietnam: Facilitating Low-Carbon and Green Agriculture Transformation

description.narrative: The project has the objective to contribute to enabling Vietnam’s low-carbon green agriculture production transformation through knowledge sharing and capacity training.The project has 2 main objectives: - Review international good practices and conduct selected strategic policy studies to inform the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (MARD) to develop a national low-carbon agriculture transition strategy. - Conduct analytical work and provide technical assistance to assist MARD in developing a practical plan for implementing the national low carbon strategy focusing on the rice subsector.
The project objective is to contribute to enabling Vietnam’s low-carbon green agriculture production transformation through knowledge sharing and capacity training.
